source_of_truth: server/dart/engine.ts and server/dart/client.ts; this file mirrors the published calculation policy for agent knowledge.

netIncome.policy: CFS prefers the consolidated comprehensive income statement; source row must match the requested basis.

capex.policy: Use the DART cash-flow statement acquisition line only; do not infer from total investing cash flow.

freeCashFlow.policy: Enabled only when both source lines are reported and CAPEX policy is satisfied.

assetTurnover.reason: Period-matched average-asset implementation is not enabled.

netDebt.policy: Exclude lease liabilities. Debt group includes short-term debt, current portions of long-term debt, long-term debt and bond-family instruments. Parent/detail bond rows must not be double counted. Group absence is zero only on a complete reconciled balance sheet.

interestCoverage.policy: Use explicit interest expense only. Do not substitute total finance costs.

roe.period_policy: Quarter and half-year use cumulative profit and are not annualized. Prior-period balance is required.

roa.period_policy: Quarter and half-year use cumulative profit and are not annualized.

eps.period_policy: For half-year/quarter cumulative requests, use the cumulative EPS field when available; never silently fall back to the 3-month field.

period_policy.income_statement: IS/CIS quarterly and semiannual requests use cumulative fields for cumulative mode and 3-month fields for quarter mode.
period_policy.cash_flow_statement: CF follows the same cumulative/quarter field selection by requested mode.
period_policy.balance_sheet: BS always uses period-end point-in-time values.
period_policy.q2: 2분기 means 3-month quarter mode; 상반기/반기는 cumulative first half.
period_policy.q3: 3분기 means 3-month quarter mode; 3분기 누적 explicitly requests cumulative 1-9 months.
period_policy.quarter_end: Do not assume June/September for fiscal years with non-December year ends. The filing's actual periodStart/periodEnd governs.
